Open the [put-away prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=put-away). On the **CSS Grid** card, select **Put away**, open **Put away** in the sidebar, then choose **Restore to library**. Finally, return to **All bookmarks** and confirm the card is back.

I’ve assumed putting away needs no destructive warning because it is reversible, hides the bookmark from the main library without altering it, and offers restoration directly on the card in its separate view.
